title: Six Metrics To Track For Car Wash Marketing - SLAM Car Wash Marketing

facts.fact: SLAM says that for CPM (cost per thousand impressions) in a brand awareness campaign, anything below $5 CPM is a win.
facts.quote: Generally speaking, anything less than $5 CPM is a win.

facts.fact: SLAM uses an illustrative average car wash ticket price of $14 when explaining return on ad spend.
facts.quote: let's say our average ticket price at a car wash is $14.

facts.fact: In SLAM's illustrative return-on-ad-spend example, the Unlimited Plan costs $30 per month.
